main_text.l: I. Oratio Dominica, ex editione novi Testamenti procurata serenissimi Principis Johannae D'Albret, interprete Johanne de Licarrague de Briscous.

l.i: Gure aita cerue tân aicena : Sanctifica bedi hire icena: Ethor bedi hire rehuma : Eguin bedi hire vorondatea ceruain becala lurrean. ere: Gure eguneco oguia igue egun: Eta quitta jetza gue gure corac, nola gucre gure, corduney quitta izen baitrauegu : Eta ez gaitz la far eraci tentationetan, baina deliura gauzac gaitch totic.

page.notes: Basque passages are copied from the scan; the italic Basque paragraph has doubtful readings marked [?]: "ez gaitz" in the line "Eta ez gaitz la far eraci", "gauzac" in "deliura gauzac gaitch totic", and "jetza gue" in "quitta jetza gue gure corac". The left-hand list of the vocabulary is set in a larger type; "Araguia" and "Arimâ" are read from the scan. The heading II is one line in print with "corum." running to the next line, joined here with the printed hyphen.
